588.name: Back Walkover Skill Clinic | Friday, March 27th | 6:30p - 7:30p (Students 5+)
588.description:
Join us on Friday, March 27th from 6:30–7:30 PM for a Back Walkover Skill Clinic!

This one-hour clinic is designed to focus on the fundamentals of the back walkover, along with age-appropriate progressions that help athletes build confidence, strength, and proper technique.

Students ages 5–14 will work on back walkovers or the progressions best suited to their skill level. For those not quite ready to perform the full skill, we’ll teach safe and effective drills to support continued growth and success.

Registration for this event is only $30! All students must register for this event prior to attending. 

 

Registration for this event will close on Friday, March 27th at 3p.

591.name: Front Handspring Skill Clinic | Friday, April 3rd | 6:30p - 7:30p (Students 5+)
591.description:
On Friday, April 3rd from 6:30p - 7:30p, we will be having a Front Handspring Skill Clinic! Students ages 5-14 will be working on drills to help strengthen their front handsprings. We will also be teaching safe skill progressions for students who may not be quiet ready to perform the full skill. Sign up today for only $30! 

 

Registration for this event will close on Friday, April 3rd at 3p.

501.name: Girls Gymnastics Spring Break Camp | 3/23 - 3/27 | 9:00a - 3:00p
501.description:
Girls Gymnastics Spring Break Camp - 3/23 - 3/27


4860 Van Gordon St Unit B Wheat Ridge, CO 80033


Gymnastics - Full Day - $335 for 5 days - Or $80 Daily Enrollment


Learn basic to advanced skills and progressions for the sport of olympic women’s artistic gymnastics in our spacious facility with spring floors, multiple trampolines and foam pits, and enclosed 4-bay Ninja Course to test your strength and agility!

Students will learn cartwheels, handstands, and key skills across all four olympic apparatuses. Vault, Bars, Beam and Floor!


*No experience necessary*! All skill levels, beginner through advanced welcome. There will be time for open gym, games, crafts, and our camper's favorite - Color Wars!

 

Camp Details

- Camp is Non-Refundable

- All students must bring a water bottle & lunch from home, we will provide a morning snack

- Campers will be separated into groups based on age and ability

- Must pre-register & pre-pay

10% Sibling Discount when 2 or more siblings are enrolled in the same week!

Attire  

Your child is welcome to wear a leotard or comfortable athletic clothing. Please send a change of clothes with younger campers. Campers will use bare feet on the gymnastics floor and ninja equipment. Long hair should be secured for safety.
